versions.subject: split global win_invoke_obfuscation_*
versions.detection:
selection_eventid:

selection:
    ImagePath|re: '.*cmd.{0,5}(?:\/c|\/r).+powershell.+(?:\$\{?input\}?|noexit).+\"'
condition: selection and selection_eventid

versions.subject: refactor: more regex avoidance
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 4697
    ServiceFileName|contains|all: 
        - 'cmd'
        - 'powershell'
selection2:
    ServiceFileName|contains:
        - '${input}'
        - 'noexit'
selection3:
    ServiceFileName|contains:
        - ' /c '
        - ' /r '
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: EventID=4697 ServiceFileName="*cmd*" ServiceFileName="*powershell*" ServiceFileName IN ("*${input}*", "*noexit*") ServiceFileName IN ("* /c *", "* /r *")
